text.20:63: They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions;
text.20:104: We are Best Aware of what they utter when their best in conduct say: Ye have tarried but a day.
text.23:17: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.
text.72:11: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.
text.72:16: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
